analysis_scope: three P1 targets plus seven fixed P0 type-II controls
reported_pb50_evidence: PDF p17 Supplementary Figure 3A: 17 PB50 in ART family tree, array-positive/type II
PDF p17 Supplementary Figure 3C: ART_17 PB50 with array -> RT -> type II partner
PDF p37 / text line 2335: PB50 type-II RT-partner pair included in co-folding

assignment_rule.collinearity: first CDS downstream in RT transcription direction, same strand, gap <=60 nt
assignment_rule.partner_length_aa: 240..330 (paper describes type II as about 270 aa)
assignment_rule.finite_sequence_support: for AH12/Machias, RT and partner global identity each >=0.80 to report-anchored PB50; seven P0 controls provide bounded context rather than a hard pairwise threshold because the paper defined partner families by profile comparison
assignment_rule.interpretation: family-locus assignment only; not functional validation

source_reference.citation: Yoon PH et al. Autonomous AI agents discover reverse transcriptases with tandem repeat arrays. Anthropic technical preprint, 2026-09-23.
